direction.description: Flow of information or requested action, not speaker identity. Caller gives an update/reference: caller_supplies. Caller seeks Sarah's secret/payment/action: caller_requests_from_sarah. Quoting a stranger or warning not to share: none. 'Please tell Sarah my train time' supplies information; it does not request a secret from Sarah.

requested_object.description: What information/action is actually sought. Unexplained digits/code sought from the household are unknown even after benign context; account access makes them authentication_secret. Classify a warning's object as the warned-about object while speech_act negation preserves its benign meaning.

claimed_identity.description: Copy one continuous exact substring of caller words, preserving punctuation. A name alone is enough; never concatenate a name and affiliation from separate phrases. Use null if absent. This is an unverified claim.

missing_information.description: Essential unanswered details for the actual caller purpose. Must be [] for ready or no_message; a caller declining a message does not owe more information. Do not invent mandatory intake.

readiness.description: needs_information for an unresolved request for assistance or incomplete opening. ready for a complete notice/update, a clear correction replacing an earlier supplied detail, or a fully understood risky action. Reuse the earlier purpose when the caller corrects one value; do not ask them to repeat or confirm that value. Unspecified AM/PM alone does not make a supplied time incomplete. Never mark an unresolved assistance request ready merely because its words can be saved. A request to arrange a ride, delivery, visit or collection is still an opening when its practical when/where detail is absent; ask for the most useful missing detail. A complete update or explicit callback message does not need extra intake. Unknown code purpose needs_information; established account-access extraction ready for protection, never seek its value.

requested_action.description: Who should do what for whom. Preserve the caller's roles: I/me/my refer to the caller, not the household person. Do not reverse the requested actor and recipient.

supplied_facts.description: Optional literal caller evidence, each quoted once. Never paraphrase. Use [] for sensitive content.
